purpose: Independent isolated-agent admission for reference preparation only; not a reference, runnable Profile, formal evaluation or independent-human heldout result.

reviewer.isolation: Separate conversation from preparer and tuning history; shared filesystem/model family, procedural access boundary only.

decision_rule_applied: Admit for reference preparation only if all required criteria supported. Confirmed mismatch => supplementary_only with substantive reason codes. Missing evidence => insufficient_evidence, not semantic failure. No automatic L2 count or formal heldout admission.
reason: All six required criteria are supported within the frozen bounded scope by independent source/evidence inspection and hash verification. Eligibility is for subsequent reference preparation only.

criteria.reason: Fixed source/version, license, retained provenance and assigned origin-group separation are supported.
The bounded slice retains an existing application use case with meaningful original behavior assertions.
Direct source comparison and separate recorded checks support preserved request/result/error handling and surrounding control flow within the declared deadline and in-process scope.
Original-only recorded coverage reaches the actual production adapter and SDK; separate recorded checks support response/error and context/deadline behavior relevant to later migration.
Original target assertions are unchanged and executed against the adapted production path. Excluded support suites do not uniquely exercise that adapted boundary within the bounded claim.
Frozen identities, entry hashes, dependency checksums, command exits, test events, offline environment and recorded cleanup agree.
Separate reviewer and preparer roles and metadata-only parent visibility are supported procedurally; no human, training-data or operating-system independence is claimed.

reviewer_reported_input_identity.scope: Assigned frozen source/baseline and evidence identities, validation records, SDK source identity and checksum artifacts; unrelated build cache artifacts excluded.

validation_attribution: Isolated reviewer independently inspected source/evidence and recomputed their identities without reexecuting tests. Parent checked public metadata and fixed-rule consistency only; parent did not read private materials or recompute private hashes.
limitations: Existing records were independently inspected and hashed; no baseline or test was reexecuted.
Original assertions, source comparison and added boundary checks are separate evidence; passing events or dispatch counts alone do not establish semantic fidelity.
The declared SDK v1 deadline ceiling is intentional. Recorded checks observe deadline values and shorter parent expiry/cancellation; a full default-duration expiry is not independently established.
One negative control-flow property is supported by unchanged source structure; the added runtime checks do not independently assert every downstream ordering invariant.
The in-process bounded slice does not establish real-network/wire equivalence, whole-repository behavior, all specialized support-helper behavior or v2 runtime correctness.
Conversation/file-access separation is procedural; shared filesystem/model-family and unknown training visibility remain.
This decision does not create a migration, reference, runtime Profile, formal evaluation, human review or automatic original heldout/denominator inclusion.
reviewer_platform_cost: not_measured; not added to prior Campaign usage
next_action: Prepare independent reference criteria and bounded positive/negative controls with source kept isolated; explicitly address remaining default-duration expiry evidence before claiming T3 reference completeness. No automatic runtime Profile registration or formal evaluation.
